text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as summer training camp was going smoothly...
an incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—2000m on turf.
This course will do, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Man, I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: To think I get to race with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It all started one hour ago—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During a break in training, Mr. C.B. suddenly came over to Mejiro Ramonu, and...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, I want to run with you... or rather, I want to race you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is it okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With just this...
it's been decided that I'll face off against the Classic Triple Crown Umamusume, Mr. C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu. One could say that right now,
you are running the most freely of all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nothing can bind you.
Swayed by no wind at all...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You made me really want to run with you!
Thanks for accepting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To have you describe me as free
is truly a great honor."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make you feel it even more.
Deep down inside your heart..."
choice_data_list: (Ramonu is motivated, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B., a Classic Triple Crown Umamusume who has also gained a wealth of race experience in the Senior Class...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "On the other hand, how much of a match can Mejiro Ramonu put up, given she's still in the Classic class with so little experience? Though, to be completely honest—"
choice_data_list: (I really want to see this showdown...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just how close can Mejiro Ramonu, boasting supreme strength in the current Tiara division, get to her? It's bound to be a nail-biter of a race...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it seemed that feeling wasn't
mine alone—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here it is!
CB-senpai and Ramonu-senpai's race!

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...! Those two are really gonna race each other!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear,
the gallery is getting bigger.
choice_data_list: I wonder where they heard about it...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just invited her like normal.
Maybe the girls watching started a rumor?
choice_data_list: What will you do, Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind.
Neither does CB."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yeah, you're right!
As long as we have each other, that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Then, before this turns into an even bigger commotion... let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~!
Good luck to both of you~~!
choice_data_list: (...Are you really going to be okay?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a lingering hint of unease at the ever-growing crowd of spectatorsâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The race is underway!
First, Mejiro Ramonu takes the lead,
steadily pulling away from Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ! Looking good, no openings at all... What a flawless, beautiful run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The race progresses with the distance between the two never closing. At first glance, Mejiro Ramonu seems to have the upper hand, but...
choice_data_list: (This is where Mr. C.B. gets scary)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Alright then!
It's about time... you let me catch you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (Here she comes! What an incredible closing kick...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ah... W-Wait a sec— Eeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... that was where the race ended.
The crowd had grown too large, nearly triggering
a stampede near the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both Mr. C.B. and Mejiro Ramonu noticed immediately and slowed down, so neither was injured, but...
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, both of them really seem fine.
...Yeah, the two of them really look like they're okay.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I've been telling you that the whole time, haven't I?
And yet, you still checked it dozens of times...
choice_data_list: If you feel even the slightest discomfort afterward, report it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I know that!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aargh, with this, I'm not even in the mood to start over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...What a shame.
Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right! ...Well then, I'm gonna go
say hi to everyone for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Why?
The spectators were unharmed, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but it's also partly my fault for not realizing
how much... buzz I'd generate, so it ended up like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing to apologize for, though,
so I figured a greeting would be just right.
choice_data_list: I'll go check on things one more time, too!
I'll go check on things one more time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What troublesome people...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time we finished attending to everything,
it was already evening.
choice_data_list: We barely got any training done, huh.
We barely got any training done, did we.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
However,
I gained something far more meaningful than that.
choice_data_list: Is that... from experience?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Joy at the possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That race.
I would have most likely lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That sheer aura CB showed at the very end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Unlike anything I had ever felt before.
It made these legs... my entire body, tremble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It was both a joy...
and an unknown terror.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...The more I chew,
the sweeter it gets...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond the Triple Tiara...
I suppose races that surpass even that
are waiting for us."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words "beyond the Triple Tiara" had come from Mejiro Ramonu's own lips for the first time...
Just hearing that made my heart race with anticipation.
choice_data_list: What's your goal beyond that?
What is your goal beyond that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: None at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: As long as this love demands it, I will simply keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
Why are you laughing?
choice_data_list: I'm just so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I honestly told her that during the Oaks, I wanted to keep watching Mejiro Ramonu run... and that I was happy to hear her answer."
choice_data_list: The Oaks was truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I heard.
choice_data_list: Wait, shouldn't we focus on the Oka Sho first—
Wait, shouldn't we focus on the Oka Sho first—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because...
she's just so innocent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I am listening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
What part of it
did you like?
choice_data_list: Her power on the steep hill in the Oka Sho was...
That sheer tenacity shown in the final stretch of the Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At Hanshin Racecourse, where the Oka Sho is held, a steep hill awaits just before the finish line. In that final moment requiring explosive speed—
choice_data_list: You charged up powerfully!
You powerfully raced your way to the top!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I experienced that hill in the Hanshin JF too, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like this will take a while.
I feel like walking for a bit—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, they walked along the beach until sundown, talking about all sorts of races with Mejiro Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "At Tokyo Racecourse, where the Oaks is held, a long, long homestretch awaits at the end of a grueling path. That moment will truly test one's mental fortitude—"
choice_data_list: You even looked like you had room to spare!
You even looked like you had room to spare from your expression!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...Well, I wonder. But that final stretch... it was fascinating—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like this will take a while.
I feel like walking for a bit—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, they walked along the beach until sundown, talking about all sorts of races with Mejiro Ramonu—
